method: Compared current Anthropic Define tools and Strict tool use docs with the full lesson. Compiled three Python fences; executed the partial local schema checker and fake SDK probe responses for no tool call, multiple calls, one valid call, empty end_turn, and list-valued parameter. Verified report classification and enum caveat. No provider/network calls.
limitations: The 2026-10-08 DeepSeek outputs, prompts, raw responses, endpoint configuration and scorer are not archived, so historical rates and causal explanations were not independently reproduced.
The probe SDK example is exercised only with a FakeClient; it has not been run against a live Anthropic endpoint or other provider.
The local contract helper checks a small project convention set; it is not a full JSON Schema validator or provider acceptance test.
Strict tool guarantees apply only to Anthropic-supported models/settings and supported schema subsets; they do not enforce authorization or business semantics.
